401920531.summary: Both sources that make a call expect No. 5 Texas Tech (5-1) to beat Oregon in a Players Era 16 consolation game at Michelob ULTRA Arena in Las Vegas (neutral site, 11:30 PM ET). Beatline projects Texas Tech 75-70, citing its structured offense; The Breakdown projects 78-70. Both teams lost on Nov 24: Texas Tech fell 72-64 to No. 25 Louisville (6-for-27 from 3, outrebounded, Jamichael Stillwell in foul trouble) and Oregon lost 90-79 to No. 16 St. John's. The matchup the AP preview points to is Texas Tech's defense (opponents shoot 35.3%) against Oregon's 54.8% shooting; Cruz Davis (15.5 points) leads Texas Tech. No injuries were reported for either team. Both projections (5 and 8 points) are inside the board's 10.5-point line.
